policy: Limits are ratchets. Lower them after reductions; raise them only with an explicit context-budget justification.
adjustment_justification: Validated lookup indices now live in the schema-of-record IR and explicit per-executor tuning now lives in sembla-cpu. The new sweep-finalization boundary adds 303 lexical tokens but cuts the largest coordinator from 555/47 lines/complexity to 430/39. After the serde parser rewrite and lookup simplifications, the backend remains 1,887 tokens below the original 178,920-token ratchet; the function, complexity, file, IR, and CUDA limits are lowered here.
